content: Yesuri abala komoma tapa-para wala rekesa
Gore amenu, neme abalade nimi-para lagisuade Epe Agalere kone pereke yoma pagalepa. Gore nimi abalade go agale madaa kone rulaoma puri paloma pagaaba pimi.
Go Gote-na epe agale neme nimi abala mogeaaripude. Gore pa kamaa kone narulasimide-le go epe agale pago piralepape. Go puma go agaleme nimi ade abuna kagaa pirape puri gialia.
E, gore ora abala go remaa pagomare neme nimi epe agale gu-rupa lagisuade: Keriso komisare naana koe elenu raayo mea rubalalo komisa. Go pisa alina remaare abalade Gote-na buk madaa lisimide.
Keriso komenaloma tapa-para rogaasimi. Abalade Gote-na agale wi buk madaa lisimi-rupa yapi repome tapa-para piruma wala rekesa.
Go puma Pita-me nipu adenaloma werepe aposel 12 page nipu adisimi.
Go puma wala werepe nipuna disaipel enaali 500 kiritaoma pirisimi rabu page adisimi. Go enaali adaapupere pimi pare medaloma abala komisimi.
Go pumare wala werepe Jems-me nipu Keriso adisa. Go puma wala werepe aposel kogono ali raayome page nipu adisimi.
Go nimumi abala adoba kiritinaloa neme page nipu adisua. Neme adisua pare oge naaki-rupa matimi pare neme nipu werepe adisua.
E, gore apo aposel kogono alinuna rikiranare nimumi ni ma-oge yaasimi. Gore abalade neme Gote-na ruru enaalinu kedaa kalala pirisuade-pulu neme go epe agale raleme aposel kogono ali mabebola lisua.

Pare Gote-me ni raba meape kone gisa-pulu ni aposel kogono ali pi. Gore nipumi nipuna raba meape kone pa kama-daa nagisa. Dia-le aposel kogono ali medaloma abalade kogono puri pale pisimide pare neme kogono kalai puma nimuna kogono ma-oge yaayo. Yapare nana kama komea kogono nape. Dia, pare Gote-na raba meape kone nana lo robaa-para saabaoma kogono puaayo.
Go pea pare neme kogono pe rabu page nimumi peme rabu page go epe agale mogelema. Go puma nimimi go agale madaa kone rulaeme.
Gote-me kome enaali raayo wala marekaalia
Gore naame Keriso komoma wala tapa-para rekesa-daa go remaa ade abuna lakelema. Go pea-le nimina rikirana piri enaalinumi abala kome enaalinuri wala narekalimi lemere ake paa-daa leme pae?
Gore kome enaali wala narekalimi yaalore abalade Gote-me Keriso page mada namarekaala pisa.

Gore Keriso tapa-para abala narekola pisa yaalore abalade Gote-me Keriso page mada namarekaala pisa. Gore Keriso tapa-para abala namarekaata pisa yaalore gore naame epe agale mada napagola pema. Go pula pea yaalore nimimi ele madaa kone rubita peme yapae?

Gore naame Gote-me Keriso tapa-para marekaasa-daa laketema. Gore gu-rupa napula pisa yaalore naame Gote madaa makirae agale tema lo pisa. Go puma Gote-me abalade Keriso namarekaala pisa yaalore Gote-me kome enaalinu page namarekaala pisa.
Gore Gote-me ora kome enaali tapa-para namarekaa-ae yaalore gore Gote-me abalade Keriso page namarekaasade lamina.
Go pumare Gote-me Keriso tapa-para namarekaala pisa yaalore gore Gote-me nimina koe ele-daa namuma rubisa pare nimi pa kamaa kone ruleme.
Go page Keriso namarekaata pisa yaalore abalade enaali medalomame Keriso madaa kone rulaoma komisimi-daare go nimu page ora komoma pa alupalima tea pema.

Gore naame su kamaa piruma Keriso madaa kone rulaoma werepe ade abuna napirula pema yaalore naame yalame komoma kodo komape kone waru meamina. Gore su kamaa piri enaali medaloma kodome komalimina pare naame pa kamaa kone rubita pema yaalore naa-para kodome waru komalimina.

Yapare go agale ora ria-daa dia-le Keriso abala komisa-daa Gote-me nipu wala marekaasa. Go pisa-pulu kome enaali raayona riri-nane nipumi marekaalia. Go pea-le Gote-me mo kome enaalinu raayo wala werepe marekaalia.
Gore komape konere ali komea Adam-me abalade go kone muma lisana su kamaa maa ipisa. Go pisa-le ali meda Keriso-me abalade kome enaali wala marekaape kone su kamaa maa waalisade.
Go agalena re gu-rupa: Naa raayo Adam-na si wanenu-le naa pa komalima. Go page naa Keriso raapu abi pima-pulu Gote-me naa raayo wala marekaalia.

Go pea pare enaalinuna marekaape yapi di-ri naa komea komea laatapu rekomare ade abuna piralima. Abala ririna mupaare Yesu Keriso rekoma pisa-le wala werepere nipu wala su kamaa epaliade yapi di rabu naa nipuna ruru raayo wala rekalima.

Nipu epalia rabu ele raayo dia yaalia. Go rabu Mudu Alinu-para surube alinu-para go su kamaa wi puri raayo page ora Gote-na lore alinu piralimi-pulu Keriso-me mea rubalia. Go puma nipumi Gote-na surube puri wala Aapa katea.
Gore Keriso mudu mapiraoma pirinare Gote-me lore alinu raayo marabuaaoma Keriso-na age rolo-para mapiraalia
Go kogono dialenaloma Keriso-me komape konena puri page lore ali-rupa rabuaaoma ma-dia yaalia.

Go agale madaare Gote-na buk-mi gu-rupa lea: Gote-me ele raayo nipuna age rolo-para maa salia. Go pepa-mere ele raayo lea-daa naame abala pagemade: Gote-me ele raayo Keriso-me surubenalo lea-pulu Gote nipuna rolo-para napiralia.
Gore Gote-me ele raayo Keriso-me surubenalo mea kalenalomare mo Siri nipuna Aapana surube rolo-para piralia. Go raburi Gote-me ele raayo nipu komeame surubalia.

Pare go wala marekaape agale ora dia yaalore enaali medalomame abala kome enaali raba mulalo kalu-ipa muaeme-le ake paa-daa peme pae? Gore ora kome ali meda wala narekola peme yaalore gore mo kome enaali raba mulalo kalu-ipa ake paa-daa mu aaeme pae?
Go page wala marekaape agale dia yaaliare gore ake paa-daa naame radaa nape kogono ade abuna palima ya?
Amenu, neme ora lalo. Gore ade abuna ni tyalo pi kogono pe. Go pea pare naana Mudu Ali Yesu Keriso raapu pima-pulu neme nimi madaa pedo puma apo agale lagiawade.

Neme abalade Efesus su-para piri makeae yana alinu raapu yada pisua. Go pisua pare ora kome enaalinuri Gote-me wala namarekaala pisa yaalore neme ake paa-daa go yada pisua ya? Gore ali medalomame gu-rupa tea: Ekerare naa komalima-pulu palaina eda no ipanu page namina. Gore Gote-me kome enaalinu namarekaala pea yaalore apo agale ora ta pema.
Go leme pare pa enaalinumi naa gu-rupa makiralimi: Naa koe alinu raapu pora pamualimade raburi naana epe kone makoyaalimi.
Go pea-le nimina koe kone giyoma epe redepo le kone salepape. Nimimi koeyae wala napipape. Enaali medalomame nimi raapu piruma Gote na-ademe-le nimu yala mapolalo talo.
Enaalinu wala rekalimi rabu yogale ora rado mealima
Pare ali medame agale gu-rupa mealia: Abala kome enaaliri ake puma wala rekalimi ya? Nimuri yogale ele nasamina muma wala piralimi yapae?
Nimiri makeya enaalinu-le pagalepa. Repena kilinuri su-para poalimi. Go pea pare abala kaapu-daa na-ayaalia-daare gore nipu rado epe-rupa mada na-opalia.
Go kilinuri nimimi poalimi rabu ora opaliade ele-rupadaa dia. Dia, go poape kiliri pa wit-na kili-para pa kili radonu page pa su aaya.
Gore Gote-me go kili madaa nipuna kone suma au katea. Go puma Gote-me repena kili rado radore nimuna yogale-rupa au rado rado katea.
Yogalere ele raayo komea nasamina kama-daa na-aaeme. Dia-le enaalinuna yogale komea-rupa aeme pare yaa yapana yogale rado aaya. Go wenana yogale page rado aaya.
Gore so yaa-para ele page su kamaa ele page rado aaya. Go puma so yaa-para wia elenuna auri rado paaya pare go su kamaa elenuna au page rado nasamina aaya.
So naare nipuna au rado-rupa pea pare kasua page nipuna au rado pea. Sogo kubanuna rikiranare nipuna aunu page rado rado pea.
Go au madaare mo kome enaalinu wala rekalimi rabu nimuna yogale rado muma piralimi. Go puma to yogale rogaaeme rabu ora abala ramea. Go pea pare wala marekaalia yogalere ora naramualia.
Yogale naame rogaaema rabu go nipu koma paoma ramea. Go pea pare yogale wala marekaalia raburi ora epe rado-rupa aoma puri palea.
Yogale mo rogaaemare pa su kamaa yogale yapare yogale wala marekaaliare ora epe rado-rupa muma piralima. Gore go su kamaa yogale aema-le epe rado yogale muma rado-rupa piralima.

Gote-na agale ria wi buk-mi gu-rupa lea: Ora abala mupaa pirisade ali Adam-re kone wasupa muma epe-rupa pirisa. Go pisa pare werepe pirisade Adam-re nipuna bi Keriso lema. Go aliri nipuna Holi Spirit-mi enaalinu puri Go ade abuna kagaa piramala palia.
Go palia pare Gote-na Holi Spirit-mi ade abuna kagaa pirape kone abala na-epea. Dia-le go su kamaa kone dialenaloma Holi Spirit-na ade abuna pirape kone mada epalia.
Gore mo mupaa pirisade ali Adam-re Gote-me go ali sumi warisa. Go pisa pare wala laapo pa Adam ali Keriso-re nipu so yaa-para piruma ipisa.
Gore naa su kamaa pima enaalinuri naa sumi warisade ali-rupa pima. Go pea pare so yaa-para puma piri enaali raayore so yaa-para piruma ipisade ali pimi.
Gore Abiri naa go sumi warili enaali pima naare yogale aaema. Go pea pare werepe page so yaa-para pia ali mada piralima.
Ame balinu-ya, neme apo agalena re waru lagialo: Naame su kamaa yogale aema rabu Gote-na Surube Su mada na-adalima. Gore abi rumaape yogalere ora epe naramuape su-daa mada nadia yaalia.
Neme epe pagaa wi agale lagialua-le waru pagalepa. Naa raayore ora nakomalima pare Gote-me naa pereke yoma kagaa enaali-rupa mapiraalia.

Werepe biugel tia rabu wagepu ari yapa piya-rupa abala kome enaalinu raayo wala rekalimi. Go puma nimu ade abuna piralimi. Go rabu Gote-me naa pa piralimade enaalinu ade abuna mapiraalia-pulu naana yogale rado-rupa ma-aulaalia.
Go rabu naa naramuape yogalere wala perekea yoma epe-rupa ade abuna naramuape-rupa aalia.

E, gore mo abala ramisade yogale rekoma ade abuna naramuape yogale ma-aulaalia. Go paliade raburi mo Gote-na buk madaa lisimide agalena re adalima. Go rabu enaalinu makomaape kone dia yaalia-pulu enaalinu ade abuna epe-rupa mada piralimi. Go madaare gu-rupa teme:
Komape ele nena puri aa-para wia pae? Go komape elere enaali mabebola tyalo puriri aa-para wia yapae?
Gore enaalinumi pupitagi neme-le go komape yapi di madaa radaa nape puri wia. Go puma mo pupitagi-na puriri rekena agaleme kalo aaya.
Go pea pare naana Mudu Ali Yesu Keriso-me naa puri mapalaaya-pulu naame apo pupitagina puri mada rabuaaniaaema. Go madaare Gote-para ora pili lamina.

Go pea-le ora nana epe ame balinu-ya, nimimi puri waru paloma rekoma paalame nakomalepape. Go puma Mudu Ali-na kogono adaapu waru palepape. Nimimi Mudu Ali-na kogono meda palimiri go kogono na-alupalia.
